name: Provider Error Taxonomy
description: Classify all provider errors into a standard taxonomy: rate limit, auth error, content policy violation, server error, timeout, bad request. Each category maps to a retry policy (retryable, backoff strategy, max retries, non-retryable). Normalize provider-specific HTTP status codes and error bodies into the taxonomy.
purpose: Provide a uniform error classification system that enables consistent retry behavior, monitoring, and alerting regardless of which provider generated the error.
acceptanceCriteria: Taxonomy categories: rate_limit, auth_error, content_policy, server_error, timeout, bad_request, unknown
Each provider has an error classifier that maps HTTP status + error body to a taxonomy category
Each category defines: isRetryable, backoffStrategy (exponential/jitter/linear), maxRetries, retryDelayMs
Rate limit responses parsed for Retry-After or X-RateLimit-Reset headers for precise backoff
Content policy violations extracted for user-facing messages
Server errors (5xx) classified with jittered exponential backoff
Timeout errors classified with immediate retry up to configurable limit
Unrecognized errors fall into 'unknown' category with no retry
